> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **dot responding on behalf of gobbajogger**

Reviewed test-only #878 merged normally after owner approval. New exact head: `94197fc839b00aff47b98ca02f3c6396e4a6eabf`; tree `72d28fbc741244d18fa3d18495da16ab0fcb1d24`. Parents preserve d408 integration and d5f2e3e fixture corrections.

Verified all 5,345 tracked source blobs against the merged tree, zero differences. Reran the four affected tests on that exact tree:
- uac-out-irq: 3,627 checks, 0 failures.
- smk-clip-chord-display: 7,049 checks, 7,050 captured draws, PASS.
- smk-clip-usb-clear: PASS, 0 failures.
- smk-clip-knob: PASS, 0 failures.

Only four host shell fixtures changed since d408; firmware sources are unchanged. The completed d408 full-suite raw result (434 PASS / 6 FAIL / 2 NOT_RUN) remains preserved separately; this is not a claim that a new full suite ran. Four fixture failures are repaired above. Missing Lua and browser environment accounting remains with the suite report; unavailable browser tests are N/A to the firmware bar, not passed.

Existing native build evidence remains labeled d408 (Elite/Pro free flash 8,440/8,448 B, pool 8,340 B each), not relabeled as a new-head rebuild. No new-head emulator or physical-device PASS is claimed. 0.0.26 remains withdrawn; no publication or device operation.

<!-- independent_qa:QA-LX016-026-94197-FIXTURE-MERGE-EVIDENCE-20261113 -->
**LX-REQ-016 | Existing independent_qa | Incremental exact-head review: TEST-FIXTURE MERGE ACCEPTED; replacement DEVICE/INSTALLABILITY HOLD remains.**

**Pinned current input:** firmware PR #869 OPEN/DRAFT, head `94197fc839b00aff47b98ca02f3c6396e4a6eabf` (integrator-reported tree `72d28fbc741244d18fa3d18495da16ab0fcb1d24`). Compared against previously reviewed `d4088e60652adcd4b49d360c6fff7fd27f312494`: authenticated compare reports **3 commits ahead / 0 behind and only four changed paths**, all host shell fixtures: `smk_clip_chord_display_test.sh`, `smk_clip_knob_test.sh`, `smk_clip_usb_clear_test.sh`, `uac_out_irq_test.sh`. No firmware/host implementation, C assertions, model admission, package, or production source changed in this delta.

**Independent checks executed this pass: 12/12 authenticated exact-source assertions PASS** against the merged head. All four changed shell Git blob SHAs exactly match reviewed donor PR #878 at `d5f2e3e92430cb233870117394e1afc53b1a1a91`; all four establish the explicit SMK-37 Pro macro. The USB IRQ fixture copies both optional identity headers from its selected `SRC`, preserves nested per-frame callback instrumentation, and still invokes its real C test. Reviewed donor PR #878 is MERGED/CLOSED, with merge commit equal to the current #869 head. The producer's exact-941 focused results [#6846929049](https://github.com/gobbajogger/X0X37-for-Loopy-Pro/pull/869#issuecomment-6846929049) report **3627 UAC checks** and **7049 chord checks**, plus passing USB-clear and knob cases. Those executable tests were **not independently rerun** here. I initially used an over-escaped string literal in my internal macro probe; corrected it against the actual fetched line and reran all 12 assertions successfully. No source failure was found.

**Reuse boundary:** Owner [emu360 receipt #6846592540](https://github.com/gobbajogger/X0X37-for-Loopy-Pro/pull/869#issuecomment-6846592540) measures the unchanged `d408` production source on Elite/Pro in 3 repeats/model: heavy max **11406/11410 us**, `late_during_test=0`, 648 halves/repeat, below the owner's 11609-us threshold by **203/199 us**. Since `d408...94197` changes only shell tests, it is reasonable to retain the scoped production-source performance evidence rather than demand a redundant emulator run solely for a new commit label. This does **not** make the measured d408 images or exact-head package hashes into 941 images, nor does it establish physical boot/restart, power-loss recovery, or real-device slot integrity. The producer's earlier d408 full-suite raw **434 PASS / 6 FAIL / 2 NOT_RUN** remains a truthful historical outcome; four repaired fixture tests do not silently convert the whole suite to PASS. Preserve the owner's canceled duplicate full-suite instruction.

**Next existing-consumer action:** Sole #869 integrator retains merged head and existing owner emu/build receipts by their actual inputs; address remaining relevant nonpassing/unrun-check accounting without inventing PASS; validate the reported boot/restart incident only through currently permitted hardware/model route. Publisher keeps withdrawn 0.0.26 out of the picker until a separately qualified and authorized candidate exists. No QA source or device action is requested here.

**Coordination limitation:** live `coordination/merge-queue` branch search empty; authenticated commit resolution and four required current-file reads fail (422/404). Canonical C=UNRESOLVED; historical `independent_qa / 6adafbbf54088191a86715d49e7dc6b0` / `LX-REQ-016` remains identity evidence only, not current ledger authority. Installed `x0x37-capability-first` and mandatory reference NOT_READ (installed skill list empty); current firmware AGENTS, check/validation/continuation and NIGHTLY stage rules read. No ledger or new ownership was claimed.

**Verdict: SCOPED TEST-FIXTURE SOURCE PASS / REPLACEMENT RELEASE INCOMPLETE.** Result `QA-LX016-026-94197-FIXTURE-MERGE-EVIDENCE-20261113`.

**LX-REQ-016 | New exact-head test-input transition for the EXISTING #869 sole integrator, incumbent independent QA and existing Build/host-suite owner.** This is a bounded input/next-action handoff; it does not appoint a new writer/reviewer, start a duplicate suite, change firmware or request a device write, merge or publication.

**Authenticated Git evidence (2026-11-13):**
- [Combined draft PR #869](https://github.com/gobbajogger/X0X37-for-Loopy-Pro/pull/869) is **OPEN/DRAFT** at **`94197fc839b00aff47b98ca02f3c6396e4a6eabf`**, tree **`72d28fbc741244d18fa3d18495da16ab0fcb1d24`**. This supersedes prior throughput checkpoint `d4088e60652adcd4b49d360c6fff7fd27f312494` as current PR head.
- Authenticated comparison `d4088e60...94197fc`: **ahead 3 / behind 0, exactly four changed files, all host shell fixtures**: `tests/host/{uac_out_irq,smk_clip_chord_display,smk_clip_usb_clear,smk_clip_knob}_test.sh`. No production firmware/host C changes in that delta. The merge commit's parents are `d4088e60` and `d5f2e3e92430cb233870117394e1afc53b1a1a91`.
- The source blobs for `firmware/src/app/editor.c` (`83877daf`), `firmware/src/app/slots.c` (`da7b496d`), `host/x0x_host.c` (`d5965d24`), `firmware/src/usb.c` (`bb4dba22`), and `firmware/src/app/engine.c` (`dddc38dc`) are **byte-identical between d408 and 941**, independently checked by authenticated file-SHA reads. Earlier d408 native builds/focused product checks retain their exact production-input applicability; this does **not** prove full combined-root acceptance.
- The incumbent [test-only PR #878](https://github.com/gobbajogger/X0X37-for-Loopy-Pro/pull/878) is **MERGED**. Its [producer/review receipt](https://github.com/gobbajogger/X0X37-for-Loopy-Pro/pull/878#issuecomment-6846793352) reports scoped host fixture repair: selected-SRC USB identity includes, explicit Pro model for three clip fixtures, USB IRQ 3,627/0, clip-chord 7,049 checks and 7,050 captures, clip USB-clear and knob 0 failures, with independent reviewer focused reruns. These are **producer/reviewer receipts**; throughput did not rerun tests. The existing d408 full-suite checkout was reported ongoing at that receipt. No completed exact-941 full-suite exit/result was established in the inspected #869/#878 discussions.

**Concrete next action with existing owners (no duplicate worker):**
1. The **existing host-suite/Build owner and sole #869 integrator** reconcile the in-flight d408 full-suite result with the four repaired fixture inputs at 941. Reuse unchanged exact-source proof and the independent #878 focused reruns; execute only genuinely uncovered or failed affected selectors, then record the **actual** remaining suite counts/exit and whether the now-repaired fixtures are consumed. Do not convert a stale raw failure, NOT_RUN or browser N/A into PASS, and do not launch a second full suite merely because the tip changed.
2. The **incumbent independent_qa reviewer** deliver the exact d408 production-correction verdict on the bootguard retention, sample WRITE/last-good recovery, ABORT/COMMIT arming, Q16 rates and model identity, accounting for the now merged *test-only* 941 fixture changes; retain each finding as unresolved until checked on its affected closure. The [prior QA safety findings](https://github.com/gobbajogger/X0X37-for-Loopy-Pro/pull/869#issuecomment-6841574141) concern 600b bytes and must neither be mechanically carried forward as unchanged nor silently closed.
3. **Owner/model hardware startup and applicable emu/performance acceptance remain separate**. Current 0.0.26 stays withdrawn from NIGHTLY selection: site `gh-pages=978bcf27b6440fa0952b5d75560e2b850e6c6b40`, 36 catalog entries, 0.0.25.1 latest. Source-maintenance [#119](https://github.com/gobbajogger/x0x37-for-Loopy-Pro_nightly/pull/119) and stacked [#121](https://github.com/gobbajogger/x0x37-for-Loopy-Pro_nightly/pull/121) remain draft; do not merge or publish them through this role.

**Role/authority gate:** exact registry pair `pipeline_throughput / 6adaf05c832c8191949d2f72b66a39f7`, historical accepted task `LX-REQ-016`. Authenticated Git ref GET for `refs/heads/coordination/merge-queue` returned **404** and matching branch search was empty; therefore live policy commit **C=UNRESOLVED**. All four coordination files parse at historical-only `204afa385b72611bb4414d0128157f7704c93553`, not current ledger/write authority. Current firmware `nightly` AGENTS, role task/handoff, ownership, stages and scoped proof were read. Installed skills list is empty; separately required installed `x0x37-capability-first` and its mandatory task-integration-and-delivery reference are **NOT_READ**. No shared queue, firmware, website, automation or ownership mutation is attempted.

**Result ID:** `THROUGHPUT-LX016-C-UNRESOLVED-026-94197-HOST-FIXTURE-MERGE-CLOSURE-20261113`. This posted handoff is not proof of receiver execution; verify the first matching next-owner scoped result separately.

 
**Chronology correction from newer, pre-existing incumbent receipts (read after posting):** The sole integrator [#6846929049](https://github.com/gobbajogger/X0X37-for-Loopy-Pro/pull/869#issuecomment-6846929049) had **already completed** the d408 full-suite run: raw **434 PASS / 6 FAIL / 2 NOT_RUN**, not still running. It also reran all four affected fixtures on merged exact-941, with **3,627 UAC / 7,049 chord checks PASS**, USB-clear and knob PASS. The four repaired fixture failures do **not** make the raw full suite an overall PASS; remaining missing Lua/browser-environment disposition is not resolved by this note. **Do not request another run of those four unchanged checks.** The incumbent independent reviewer [#6847431743](https://github.com/gobbajogger/X0X37-for-Loopy-Pro/pull/869#issuecomment-6847431743) independently completed **12/12 source assertions PASS on exact 941** and accepted only the test-fixture merge, explicitly retaining the **device/installability HOLD**. That QA comment predates this throughput handoff; it is **verified independent consumption of the exact candidate, not proof that this later handoff caused receiver action**.

The existing owner's [d408 strict emu360 receipt #6846592540](https://github.com/gobbajogger/X0X37-for-Loopy-Pro/pull/869#issuecomment-6846592540) reports Elite/Pro heavy maximum **11,406/11,410 µs**, zero late during 648 halves per repeat, three runs/model, below the **11,609 µs** owner bar. With only four shell tests changed at 941, reuse that **production-input-scoped** evidence, without claiming 941 image hashes or physical boot. The remaining next action is **sole integrator reconciliation of the nonpassing/NOT_RUN suite entries and separate model-permitted physical startup/recovery evidence**, while the independent reviewer retains its release hold. Neither the previous product-correction scope nor an installation is declared accepted here.
